description: Flat metadata schema for individual virus-host protein interaction evidence records derived from affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS) during viral infection studies.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this interaction record or row in the metadata table.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study or project.

dataset_id.descr: Identifier for the dataset or submission containing this record.

virus_name.descr: Common name of the virus studied, e.g. SARS-CoV-2, influenza A virus, HIV-1.

virus_taxonomy_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy ID for the virus, if available.

virus_strain.descr: Virus strain, isolate, or variant name, if applicable.

virus_genome_type.descr: Virus genome type, e.g. RNA, ssRNA+, ssRNA-, dsRNA, DNA.

host_species.descr: Host organism species, e.g. Homo sapiens, Mus musculus.

host_taxonomy_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy ID for the host species, if available.

host_cell_line.descr: Host cell line used for infection or expression, e.g. HEK293T, Vero E6.

host_cell_type.descr: More specific host cell type or primary cell description, if available.

host_tissue.descr: Host tissue or tissue origin of the cells, if known.

infection_status.descr: Infection state of the sample, e.g. infected, mock-infected, transfected, uninfected control.

infection_moi.descr: Multiplicity of infection used, as a numeric value when applicable.

infection_time_post_infection_h.descr: Time post infection at sample collection, in hours.

viral_protein_bait_name.descr: Name of the viral protein used as bait in the affinity purification, if applicable.

viral_protein_bait_accession.descr: Protein accession or identifier for the viral bait protein.

host_protein_prey_name.descr: Name of the host protein identified as the interaction partner.

host_protein_prey_accession.descr: Protein accession or identifier for the host prey protein.

protein_id_namespace.descr: Identifier namespace used for protein accessions, e.g. UniProtKB, RefSeq, Ensembl.

apms_experimental_system.descr: Experimental system used, typically affinity purification coupled to mass spectrometry (AP-MS).

affinity_tag.descr: Affinity tag used to pull down the bait protein, e.g. FLAG, HA, GFP, Strep-tag.

antibody_name.descr: Antibody used for immunoprecipitation or detection, if applicable.

sample_preparation_protocol.descr: Brief protocol description for sample lysis, affinity purification, and digestion.

crosslinking_used.descr: Whether crosslinking was used prior to affinity purification.

crosslinking_reagent.descr: Crosslinking reagent name, if crosslinking was used, e.g. formaldehyde, DSSO.

control_condition.descr: Description of the negative or mock control used for interaction calling.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier or number for the biological replicate.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier or number for the technical replicate.

replicate_count.descr: Total number of replicates supporting the record, when summarized at row level.

mass_spectrometer_model.descr: Mass spectrometer model used, e.g. Orbitrap Fusion, Q Exactive.

chromatography_system.descr: LC system or chromatography setup used for peptide separation.

fragmentation_method.descr: Fragmentation method used in MS/MS, e.g. HCD, CID, ETD.

search_software.descr: Software used for peptide/protein identification, e.g. MaxQuant, Mascot, Proteome Discoverer.

search_software_version.descr: Version of the search software used.

database_used.descr: Protein sequence database used for searching, including source and version if known.

fdr_threshold.descr: False discovery rate threshold applied for peptide or protein identification, expressed as a fraction or percent depending on reporting convention.

interaction_call_method.descr: Method used to infer interaction significance from AP-MS data, e.g. SAINT, MiST, fold-change threshold.

interaction_confidence_score.descr: Numerical confidence score for the interaction call, according to the study's scoring method.

interaction_confidence_level.descr: Categorical confidence assignment, e.g. high, medium, low, if provided by the study.

spectral_count.descr: Observed spectral count supporting the prey protein identification in this record.

peptide_count.descr: Number of unique peptides assigned to the prey protein.

sequence_coverage_percent.descr: Percent sequence coverage of the identified protein, if reported.

enrichment_fold_change.descr: Enrichment of the prey protein in bait pull-down versus control, as fold-change.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance value for the interaction or enrichment test.

adjusted_p_value.descr: Multiple-testing corrected p-value or q-value for the interaction.

interaction_type.descr: Type of interaction evidence, e.g. physical association, co-complex, predicted indirect association.

direct_interaction_evidence.descr: Whether the record provides evidence for a direct physical interaction rather than co-complex association.

subcellular_localization.descr: Primary subcellular location of the interaction or bait/prey evidence, e.g. nucleus, cytoplasm, ER.

infection_stage.descr: Stage of infection at the time of sampling, e.g. early, mid, late.

treatment_condition.descr: Any additional treatment applied, e.g. interferon, inhibitor, drug, temperature shift.

temperature_c.descr: Culture or incubation temperature in degrees Celsius during the experiment.

sample_amount_ug.descr: Amount of input protein or lysate used for purification, in micrograms.

instrument_run_date.descr: Date the mass spectrometry run was acquired, if available.

raw_data_accession.descr: Repository accession for raw MS data, e.g. ProteomeXchange, PRIDE, MassIVE.

processed_data_accession.descr: Repository accession for processed results or supplementary tables, if available.

publication_doi.descr: DOI of the publication describing the experiment or record.

license.descr: License or reuse terms applicable to the record or associated data.

created_date.descr: Date the record was created in the metadata table.

updated_date.descr: Date the record was last updated.

curator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person who curated the record.

notes.descr: Additional free-text comments relevant to interpretation or reproducibility.
